rationale: The current recurrent-tail/export path is already strong, while recent loss-curriculum and float-budget variants regressed badly. This edit spends the run on an unspent data-order hypothesis: under a 600s cap, always starting at shard 0 / token 0 front-loads the same prefix of FineWeb. A deterministic random shard rotation plus seq_len-aligned initial offset should diversify what the fixed step budget sees without changing shapes, eval, quantization, or the hot training step.
title: Randomized Training Stream Start
